qualification.statement: This small synthetic corpus validates evaluator plumbing and candidate comparisons; it cannot establish release accuracy.

exclusionRules: No live credentials or routable infrastructure addresses
No release accuracy claim from this harness corpus

splitPurpose.DEVELOPMENT: Prompt, label-map, threshold, and evaluator development only.
splitPurpose.EVALUATION: Frozen comparison inputs that must not be used for tuning.
splitPurpose.CHALLENGE: Unicode, instruction-like content, repeated mentions, Markdown, density, adjacency, mixed rules-and-contextual entity families, and long-context robustness checks.
